# ZTools

> ZTools is a free collection of 570+ developer & creator tools — JSON formatters, password generators, image compressors, regex testers, QR generators, PDF tools, and more. The vast majority run entirely in the user's browser (no signup, no upload, no data leaves the device); a small paid Growth Suite adds AI-assisted SEO tools that need a sign-in and the user's own API key.

## Key URLs

- App: https://ztools.zaions.com
- Documentation: https://ztools-docs.zaions.com
- GitHub (docs): https://github.com/aoneahsan/ztools-docs
- Author: https://aoneahsan.com

## Highlights

- 570+ tools across 20 categories (Text, PDF, Image, Data, Generator, Encoding, Conversion, SEO, Math, Health, Education, Finance, Productivity, Media, Design, Developer, Extractor, Legal, Utility, Growth)
- Browser-only processing — Canvas, Web Audio, SubtleCrypto, Web Speech, IndexedDB
- Free, no signup, no email gate, no paywall
- Open-source documentation
- Mobile apps (Android shipped, iOS pending)
- Privacy-first by design

## Documentation structure

- `/docs/intro` — overview
- `/docs/getting-started` — usage walkthrough
- `/docs/tools` — full tool catalog (organized by category)
- `/docs/guides` — long-form how-to tutorials
- `/blog` — release notes and dev journal

## Analytics & privacy

The documentation site optionally uses up to four third-party tools — Google Analytics 4 (page traffic, IP-anonymized), Microsoft Clarity (anonymized recordings + heatmaps), Amplitude (page views + downloads, no form/element capture), and Sentry (10%-sampled error reports, no session replay, no PII). Each is gated by an env var; absent secrets mean the corresponding tool's script does not ship. Full disclosure: https://ztools-docs.zaions.com/docs/privacy.

The main app at ztools.zaions.com processes everything browser-side; tool inputs never reach a server.
